quote.translation: The reason that a particular face shown by a die is in general taken to have the character of the contingent is that it is thought against the background of the possibility of six faces, which is to say that we think it could equally have been any of the other five.

quote.translation: Probability theory, certainly, will seek some constancy here and try to exclude chance.

quote.translation: Yet what is this so-called exclusion of chance?

regions.text: 然しながらその謂はゆる偶然の除外とは何であるか。
確翠とは何であるか。一事象の生起の確率とは、その事象の生起に都合の良い場合の数がすべての可能的な場合の数に對する比をいふのである。すなはち、都合の良い場合の数をずべての可能な場合の數で割つて得る商が確率である。

quote.translation: The probability of the occurrence of an event is the ratio of the number of cases favourable to its occurrence to the number of all possible cases; in other words, probability is the quotient obtained by dividing the number of favourable cases by the number of all possible cases.

regions.text: それ故に、賽の遊戲に開して確率論が規定するところは、一定の賽の目の現出および不現出のすべての可能な場合と、その目の現出する「都合の良い偶然的な場合との間に存する数量的開係に過ぎない。

quote.translation: What probability theory determines with regard to the play of dice is consequently no more than the quantitative relation between all the possible cases in which a particular face of the die appears or does not appear and the "favourable" contingent cases in which that face appears.

regions.text: それには饗ころが完全に同質で相稱である場合と完全さが幾らか映けてゐる場合とによつて相遠があるが完全であると假定して先驗的確率として立てられる蓋然法則はただ各々の整の目が現はれることに1一6の確率があるといふだけである。六同に謝して一同あらはれることが蓋然であるといふたけである。

quote.translation: There is a difference here between a die that is perfectly homogeneous and symmetrical and one whose perfection is somewhat lacking, but if we assume it to be perfect, the law of probability that is set up as a priori probability says only that each face of the die has a probability of 1/6 of appearing, that is, only that appearing once in six throws is probable.

regions.text: しかもこの理論上の数闘係は實際においては無敷の場合の穂和において理念的に妥當するだけであ

quote.translation: This theoretical quantitative relation, moreover, is ideally valid in practice only for the sum of innumerable cases, and if the number of throws is small the results may even be extremely lopsided.
